_comment: FairwayOS Demo Mode config TEMPLATE. Every value below is ILLUSTRATIVE and must
be replaced: these numbers are generic placeholders, NOT measurements of any
particular clip, and they describe nothing generally. Replace the interval, ROI,
seeds, phases and corrections with your own clip's values (demo-setup writes
them for you). See docs/demo-mode.md for the semantics of each field.
interval.end_seconds is EXCLUSIVE; frame indices are zero-based SOURCE frames.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored by the schema, so a config can

timing.source_cadence_caveat: illustrative: source playback timeline; original action/capture speed unverified, replay or slow motion possible

_why_automatic_until_frame: A flight that outruns the template search (100-220 px per frame) is tracked by
operator corrections. automatic_until_frame stops the MATCHER there while still
honouring operator anchors past it, so no template match on a stretch the
operator took the tracker off can be published as an automatic observation.

notes: illustrative template values only - they are not measurements of any clip and must be replaced; operator notes for a real run are recorded in demo_provenance.json
